exam.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Functional Consultant
exam.study_prerequisites: Applied supply-chain and Dynamics 365 SCM experience across product/inventory data, procurement, sales, quality, assets, advanced warehouse/mobile execution, transportation, costing and master planning, plus the ability to trace order, inventory, work and planning states end to end.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Implement and manage supply chain processes
Implement warehouse management and transportation management

review.notes: Every June 20, 2025 subobjective is mapped to a product, inventory, order, quality, asset, warehouse, mobile, transport or planning object/state, configuration, evidence, failure and recovery decision. Three scenarios, eight labs and 36 original checks cover all five domains. All 17 URLs are cataloged: 16 reachable and Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The guide records the active 100-minute English/Japanese exam, free Practice Assessment, 50h07 selected official paths, five-day course, MIT course labs and explicit freshness boundaries for the older blueprint and commercial supplements.

findings.title: October minor revisions require explicit mapping
findings.evidence: Live October 21 page contains 101 bullets and explicitly names Planning Optimization.
findings.recommendation: Map every bullet and retain June baseline for earlier appointments.
findings.resolution: Map every bullet and retain June baseline for earlier appointments.

findings.title: Location boundary and order-committed reservations affect allocation
findings.evidence: Batch/license-plate demand reservations can constrain warehouse allocation and bypass location directives.
findings.recommendation: Correct hierarchy wording and add exceptions and work diagnostics.
findings.resolution: Correct hierarchy wording and add exceptions and work diagnostics.

findings.title: Handling unit is independent of commercial price unit
findings.evidence: WMS unit sequence requires inventory-unit alignment and configured conversions.
findings.recommendation: Add case/each quantity-value example and variant-unit verification.
findings.resolution: Add case/each quantity-value example and variant-unit verification.

findings.title: Inspection sample is not the inventory hold
findings.evidence: Manual quality-order quantity controls blocking; automatic sampling and full-block settings differ.
findings.recommendation: Add 100-unit/10-unit example and explicit reservation/shipping evidence.
findings.resolution: Add 100-unit/10-unit example and explicit reservation/shipping evidence.

findings.title: WMS quality uses a different work and blocking flow
findings.evidence: WMS-specific quality association does not support Full blocking; client registration does not create the same sampling work as mobile processing.
findings.recommendation: Separate WMS work from basic quality and require proof of full receipt hold.
findings.resolution: Separate WMS work from basic quality and require proof of full receipt hold.

findings.title: Quarantine support differs in WMS
findings.evidence: WMS-enabled quarantine processing is limited to sales returns.
findings.recommendation: Bound the quarantine lab and clarify finished versus ended states.
findings.resolution: Bound the quarantine lab and clarify finished versus ended states.

findings.title: Recalculation is not inventory settlement
findings.evidence: Close settles periodic-model issues to receipts; recalculation adjusts without settlement and adjustments use original posting accounts.
findings.recommendation: Clarify model, cutoff and reversal order.
findings.resolution: Clarify model, cutoff and reversal order.

findings.title: Calendar entry does not prove work-order creation
findings.evidence: Both line and scheduling-dialog auto-create settings are needed; functional-location plan criteria changes remove related entries.
findings.recommendation: Add creation controls and schedule regeneration evidence.
findings.resolution: Add creation controls and schedule regeneration evidence.

findings.title: Physical possession does not transfer ownership
findings.evidence: Posted ownership-change journal creates company receipt and Consignment-origin PO.
findings.recommendation: Trace Owner dimension, journal posting and generated PO invoice.
findings.resolution: Trace Owner dimension, journal posting and generated PO invoice.

findings.title: Transfer voyages cannot reuse purchase GIT setup
findings.evidence: Transfer-order voyages require GIT disabled and post estimated costs at shipment.
findings.recommendation: Separate purchase/transfer workflows and add allocation example.
findings.resolution: Separate purchase/transfer workflows and add allocation example.

findings.title: Mobile authentication and worker sessions differ
findings.evidence: User-based interactive option recommended; device-code no longer recommended and logoff/sign-out affect different state.
findings.recommendation: Add identity/handoff tests without weakening tenant security.
findings.resolution: Add identity/handoff tests without weakening tenant security.

findings.title: Current mobile fixes warrant regression tests
findings.evidence: 4.1.6 fixes quantities above 20 resetting to zero; 4.1.5 fixes duplicate request submission after timeouts.
findings.recommendation: Add installed-build quantity and server-completion checks before retry.
findings.resolution: Add installed-build quantity and server-completion checks before retry.

findings.title: Installed and supported mobile versions differ
findings.evidence: V3 support ended May 2026; V4 rolling 12-month rule starts May 1 2027.
findings.recommendation: Add dated lifecycle guidance, device inventory and follow-up.
findings.resolution: Add dated lifecycle guidance, device inventory and follow-up.

findings.title: Planning Optimization always uses dynamic negative-day tolerance
findings.evidence: Engine-specific calculation uses replenishment/due dates plus negative days; legacy toggle has no effect.
findings.recommendation: Correct days wording and add day-8/day-9 worked comparison.
findings.resolution: Correct days wording and add day-8/day-9 worked comparison.

findings.title: Preserved planned supply and received stock use different controls
findings.evidence: Feature requires supported build/flag; actual run can override plan and received stock outside positive days needs another setting.
findings.recommendation: Add effective-run evidence and excess/received-stock caveats.
findings.resolution: Add effective-run evidence and excess/received-stock caveats.

findings.title: Official example dates are internally inconsistent
findings.evidence: The line-change CTP example has inconsistent ship/receipt date arithmetic.
findings.recommendation: Retain prerequisites and general behavior, omit inconsistent dates, and schedule a research recheck with sandbox limitation.
findings.resolution: Retain prerequisites and general behavior, omit inconsistent dates, and schedule a research recheck with sandbox limitation.

blog_intake.author: Sameer Verma
blog_intake.notes: Relevant public SCM and roadmap sections read. Accept supplier-delay evidence and approval exercise; previews/future features not asserted generally available or added as exam objectives.

blog_intake.author: Michael Fruergaard Pontoppidan and Denis Conway
blog_intake.notes: Historical usability and shift-handoff exercise; current product docs control authentication/build/support. No recommendation to install old binary or enable legacy flow.

offline_checks: Ten synthetic case/unit/value, sample, allocation and delay arithmetic assertions; no business transaction or product execution

limitations: Accepted June 20 baseline retained; October 21 objectives mapped separately. Product release notes and previews do not redefine exam scope.

No Dynamics environment, handheld, authentication, planning, costing, quality, maintenance or inventory transaction was executed. Ten labs remain learner exercises; arithmetic checks are offline only.

CTP line-change documentation includes inconsistent example dates; guide uses supported prerequisites/behavior without copying those dates and schedules a recheck. Sandbox behavior remains unverified.
Learn path landing pages checked, not individual modules or current total durations. Earlier 50h07 total is historical. Course-lab README reviewed, not individual handouts.

MeasureUp metadata last updated March 2023 includes obsolete prerequisite; current objective coverage unproven. Udemy blocked. No paid questions, signed-in Practice Assessment contents or partner event seats reviewed.
Relevant blog text read; demos, customer outcomes and preview deployment not verified. Roadmap CSV/RSS ingestion remains unimplemented.
Same-context AI research and repair; independent and human review pending.
